The average height of a Chinese man varies depending on the age group and time period considered. For adult Chinese males aged 18–44, the average height was approximately 169.7 cm (about 5 ft 7 in) as of 2020 [d6][d1]. For 19-year-old Chinese males specifically, the average height in 2019 was 175.7 cm (about 5 ft 9 in), according to a Lancet study and China's National Health Commission [d4][d9][d8]. This difference reflects both the age cohort measured and a well-documented upward trend: between 1985 and 2019, the average height of 19-year-old Chinese men increased by nearly 9 centimeters, the largest male height increase of any country surveyed [d8][d4]. Healthline similarly lists China's average male height at approximately 69.17 inches (~175.7 cm), consistent with the younger cohort figure [d5].
